question: Who was elected as Vice-President of the Constituent assembly in year 1946?
solution:
The correct answer is __**HC Mookherjee**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• H**arendra Coomar Mookerjee was elected as the Vice-President of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946. **
 
• The constitutional advisor to the constituent assembly was B. N Rao.
 
• The constituent assembly adopted the Indian constitution on 26th November 1949.
 
• B.R. Ambedkar was the chairman of the drafting committee.
 
• G. V. Mavlankar was the first speaker of the Lok Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constituent Assembly was formed for the creation of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Constituent Assembly was formed in July 1946 based on the recommendations of the Cabinet Mission.
 
• As a prominent leader of congress, Shri Rajendra Prasad worked with Mahatma Gandhi and other leaders.
 
• Rajendra Prasad worked as the longest-serving President of India (1950 to 1962).
 
• Rajendra Prasad was elected as the first President of India on 26th January 1950.
